format: Native 9:16 social pieces, 15 to 20 s each, muted-first with burned-in captions, web loudness target (-14 LUFS, -1 dBTP)
status: Flux-style prompts ready; waiting on Flux 3 generations from the OpenArt app
why: Test of OpenArt's Flux 3 video while it is unlimited. Flux 3 is not exposed through the OpenArt MCP connector (not in openart_model_list on 2026-09-21), so the clips are generated in the OpenArt app by hand, then picked up here with openart_creation_list and downloaded from each item's url.

generation_in_app.settings: aspect 9:16, 1080x1920 if offered (else the highest portrait size), 6 to 8 s per clip (5 to 6 s for D1), audio off, one output per prompt
generation_in_app.naming: Nothing to name; the pickup matches on the prompt text, so paste each prompt exactly as written below
generation_in_app.pickup: openart_creation_list (mediaType video) lists the app generations with model, prompt and a download url; save to clips/<file> as listed per clip

reuse.shared_style: spots/gbx-commercial shared_style, verbatim, plus the portrait framing sentence
reuse.narration: spots/gbx-commercial/audio/narration-all-lines.m4a split with narration-lines.py; each piece uses one existing line (1, 3, 4, 5), so no new voice generation
reuse.music: spots/gbx-commercial/audio/music-bed.m4a, one take stretched with atempo, never looped
reuse.captions: captions-9x16.py with the caption_lines below as the words and a words file from the split narration

shared_style: Cinematic brand film, editorial and premium. Dark charcoal and deep teal palette with warm off-white highlights, fine film grain, soft directional light, shallow depth of field, slow deliberate camera movement. Real-feeling Australian professionals in their thirties to fifties, diverse, natural and unposed, in a modern Melbourne office with the city skyline through glass. No stock-photo smiles, no pointing at screens, no logos, no text of any kind on screen. Minimal music: a low ambient pad with a soft piano motif, quiet room tone. Voice always clear above the music.
portrait_framing: Vertical 9:16 portrait frame, 1080x1920. The subject and every essential action sit in the centre column of the frame with head room above and desk or floor below; nothing important at the left or right edge. One continuous shot, one scene, no cuts. Nobody looks at the camera. Absolutely no readable text, letters, words or numbers anywhere, on any wall, screen or paper. Picture only, no audio.

pieces.name: clearer-picture
caption_lines: Most businesses don't need more advice.

clips.on_screen: Close portrait shot of a desk: a hand closes a thick folder of reports and pushes it aside, a phone face down, a coffee; above, the window and the Melbourne skyline soft. Two beats: the pile, then the clear desk.
clips.prompt: A hand in a navy sleeve closes a thick folder of paper reports on a light timber desk and slides it out of frame, leaving a blank notebook, a black pen and a white coffee cup centred on the desk. Vertical 9:16 close shot; the camera drifts slowly up toward the window, where the Melbourne skyline sits soft and out of focus. Shot on Sony A7IV, 35mm lens, warm off-white window light against dark charcoal and deep teal shadow, fine film grain.

clips.on_screen: Portrait: a founder in her forties at a whiteboard draws one simple rising line with three marks, turns to a colleague beside her. Whiteboard fills the centre column, the two of them in profile.
clips.prompt: A woman in her forties in a charcoal blazer draws one plain rising line with three small marks on a clean white whiteboard, then turns to a colleague in his thirties beside her, who nods; both stay in profile, talking to each other. Vertical 9:16 medium shot, slow push-in. Shot on Sony A7IV, 50mm lens, soft directional window light from frame left, deep teal shadow behind, warm highlights on their faces, fine film grain, the whiteboard blank apart from her line.

pieces.name: ai-earns-its-keep
caption_lines: And AI that actually earns its keep.
Practical, governed, and only where it helps.

clips.on_screen: Portrait: a man in his fifties at a standing desk, laptop with plain matte lid facing him, an office printer beside him hands him a page; he reads it and nods. Two beats: the wait, then the page.
clips.prompt: A man in his fifties with grey hair stands at a standing desk behind a laptop whose plain matte lid faces the camera, screen toward him. A small office printer beside him slides out a single blank white page; he takes it, reads it and gives a small satisfied nod. Vertical 9:16 medium shot, slow push-in. Shot on Sony A7IV, 50mm lens, warm off-white key light on his face, the open-plan office soft and dark in deep teal behind, fine film grain.

clips.on_screen: Portrait: an open-plan office at dusk from above; desk lamps come on one after another down the centre of the frame, like a network lighting up. No people close to camera.
clips.prompt: Rows of desks in a long open-plan office at dusk recede down the centre of the frame toward a glass wall and the Melbourne city lights. Desk lamps switch on one after another from the nearest desks to the farthest, warm points spreading through deep teal shadow, a few people small and distant at their desks. Vertical 9:16 high wide shot, very slow forward drift. Shot on Sony A7IV, 24mm lens, warm lamp light against dark charcoal, fine film grain, screens dark.

pieces.name: money-plainly
caption_lines: We also teach people about money.
Plainly, at work, in language a whole team can follow.

clips.on_screen: Portrait: a small team around a lunchroom table, one woman explains with three coffee cups pushed into a row; others lean in. Table centred, faces in three-quarter profile.
clips.prompt: Four colleagues of different ages sit around a lunchroom table in three-quarter profile. A woman in her thirties in a teal jumper slides three white coffee cups into a row and gestures from one cup to the next as she explains; the others lean in and a man in his fifties laughs quietly, all talking to each other. Vertical 9:16 medium shot, slow lateral drift. Shot on Sony A7IV, 35mm lens, warm window light, deep teal shadow, dark charcoal walls, plain cups, fine film grain.

clips.on_screen: Portrait close: a notebook page where a hand draws three plain stacked bars in pen, then underlines the tallest. Nothing legible.
clips.prompt: A hand holding a fountain pen draws three plain rectangular bars side by side on an open notebook, each taller than the last, then rules one firm line under the tallest bar and sets the pen down. Vertical 9:16 close shot looking down, camera locked. Shot on Sony A7IV, 85mm macro lens, shallow focus on the pen tip, warm off-white light from the left, the dark table and room falling into deep teal shadow, fine film grain, the page otherwise blank.

pieces.name: free-tools-first
caption_lines: Free tools before you ever hire us.
A ten-day Diagnostic when you're ready.

clips.on_screen: Portrait: a woman on a tram or at a cafe window holds her phone in the centre of the frame, screen a plain soft gradient facing away, thumb scrolling; she smiles slightly. Cut to the real tools page capture.
clips.prompt: A woman in her forties sits by a cafe window holding her phone upright, the screen tilted away from the camera and showing a plain soft grey gradient, her thumb scrolling slowly, a small smile. A Melbourne street sits soft and out of focus through the glass behind her. Vertical 9:16 medium close shot, camera locked. Shot on Sony A7IV, 50mm lens, morning window light, warm off-white highlights against dark charcoal and deep teal, shallow depth of field, fine film grain.

clips.on_screen: The real GBX tools page in a phone frame with the scroll and the Diagnostic wizard steps.

assembly: Per piece: stitch-commercial.py with CLIPS=<two clips>, the end card as the tail, LOUDNESS=web; then captions-9x16.py. Verify strip, silencedetect, loudness line, yuv420p, audio length; send a 720x1280 review copy.
prompt_style: Written with the prompt-optimizer skill (.claude/skills/prompt-optimizer, Flux family): descriptive sentences that lead with the subject, under 80 words, present tense, one camera move per shot, a camera body and lens named, one strong lighting description, positives instead of negatives (blank page, screen dark, plain cups) because Flux ignores negative prompts, no quality tags and no weight syntax. Aspect ratio is set in the app, not in the prompt.
